Ivy (PM): Heads-up: prototyping a denser "run review" list for prompt-sets. Goals: let reviewers scan regressions faster, reduce clicks for approvals, and make diffs keyboard-friendly. Main proposals: compact row height, inline mini-scorecard, and a contextual approve menu. Mock: https://figma.com/run-review-dense
Jonas (Design): Love the density idea. Two visual concerns: 1) long model outputs crowd the row; suggest collapsing with a single-line excerpt + "expand" chevron. 2) need clear affordance for edited scorecards vs original (tiny pencil + timestamp).
Pri (Frontend): Implementation notes: virtualized list is a must. For expand, we'll lazy-render the full output on demand. Inline mini-scorecard can be a lightweight react memo component to avoid re-renders. We should also batch delta requests: fetch per-run summary first, then fetch per-test details on expand.
Harper (A11y): Accessibility notes: compact rows must still have 44px min touch target for mobile. Keyboard flow: row focus -> expand -> diff content -> approve menu. Use aria-expanded on rows and role="listitem" with an aria-describedby pointing to the delta text. Also ensure color isn't the only signal for regressions (use +/- text).
Liam (QA): For the approve flow: suggest an intermediate confirmation for bulk approve that lists how many tests have negative deltas and flaky marks. Also flag any test with output-length > 2000 chars to avoid accidental approvals without review.
Ivy (PM): CTA copy thoughts: primary = "Approve selected", destructive CTA = "Request changes". For per-row menu: "Approve test" / "Request changes" / "Mark flaky" / "Add comment". Keyboard shortcut proposal: j/k to move rows, space to open row menu, a = approve current, r = request changes.
Jonas (Design): Will wire up a tiny badge system: green "+X%" or red "-X%" with textual sign and tooltip showing baseline vs candidate numbers. For flakiness, we'll use an outlined amber badge labeled "Flaky".
Pri (Frontend): Backend needs to expose run-level summary endpoint with per-test delta and flags (flaky, long_output, review_comment_count). ETA: API proto in 2 days, frontend prototype after that. We'll include an optimistic UI for approve with undo.
Harper (A11y): Additions: screen reader announcement when bulk actions complete (e.g., "5 tests approved"). Ensure undo toast is keyboard reachable and has role="status" for SRs. I'll draft an a11y checklist for the PR.
Liam (QA): Edge cases: concurrent approvals -> conflict banner on next reload; long outputs that contain HTML should be sanitized and shown in preformatted block. Also tests that were updated while reviewing should surface a small "updated since you opened" banner.
ui-bot: preview deployed -> https://preview.redwood.ai/runs/1779998888/dense-list; branch git -> github.com/redwood/repo/pull/578
Ivy (PM): Plan: Jonas + Pri to prototype dense list + expand behavior, Harper writes a11y PR checklist, Liam creates test matrix for bulk/edge cases. Review in Thurs product crit. Thanks! :sparkles:
